Roblox Cleaner Lite

A portable utility for reviewing and cleaning selected Roblox caches and old logs.

Prerelease · v0.2.0
View prereleaseRepositoryGet help

What it does

  • Preview paths, file counts, and sizes
  • Retention filters and a deeper scan preset
  • Cancellation, process checks, and local reports

Requirements

Windows 10/11 with built-in Windows PowerShell 5.1 and WPF.

Getting started

Obtain the complete project package, then run Start-Roblox-Cleaner.cmd. Scan and preview first. Cleanup requires confirmation and permanently deletes selected files.

Release notes, integrity & license

Read the current project documentation before installing. Where a release supplies checksums or signed manifests, use the instructions for that exact package. Check the repository’s license and third-party notices before reusing code or assets.
